description: Rust crates for PostgreSQL SQL: pgtk-sql parses SQL as the PostgreSQL raw parser does (versions 14 to 19 beta), pgtk-catalog models the system catalog, pgtk-analyze does parse analysis (types, result columns, errors) with no server, and pgtk-psql reads psql scripts.
rules: pgtk-sql, pgtk-psql and pgtk-analyze each need exactly one PostgreSQL version feature: pg14, pg15, pg16, pg17, pg18 or pg19-beta. The default is pg17. The build stops with zero or with two or more.
To select a version other than pg17, set default-features = false and one version feature, for example: pgtk-sql = { version = "0.1", default-features = false, features = ["pg16"] }.
A crate between your crate and pgtk-sql must use default-features = false on pgtk-sql and forward the version features. If not, Cargo feature unification can turn on two versions.
pgtk_sql::document::parse_sql parses a document of many statements. It needs the spans feature of pgtk-sql.
To parse one statement, use: let lexed = pgtk_sql::lex(sql); let mut input = lexed.input(); then pgtk_sql::ast::Statement::parse(&mut input).
pgtk_catalog::fixture::pg17() gives a built-in PostgreSQL 17 catalog with no server. It needs the fixture feature of pgtk-catalog.
In pgtk-analyze, the Grammar Version is the Cargo feature and the Target Version is a run-time value in Settings. The Target Version must not be newer than the Grammar Version.
Analysis never changes the Session. Apply analysis.session_effect to the Session yourself before you analyse the next statement.
AnalyzeError::Unsupported means that pgtk-analyze cannot analyse the statement yet. It is not a PostgreSQL error. AnalyzeError::Diagnostic is the error that PostgreSQL gives.
The build script of pgtk-sql generates the parser and is slow at opt-level 0. Set opt-level = 3 in [profile.dev.build-override] and [profile.release.build-override] of your workspace root.
pgtk-oracle, pgtk-psql-oracle, pgtk-test-server, pgtk-test-features and pgtk-catalog-xtask are for development and tests of pgtk. Do not add them as dependencies of your crate.
